name: Employment Visa (Labour Clearance + Residence Card)

requirements.blocker_text: Foreign workers must generally be between 21 and 60 years old.

The employer must obtain Labour Clearance (a work permit) from the Ministry of Labour, which includes an Omanisation test -- demonstrating no suitably qualified Omani candidate is available, particularly for administrative and sales roles; certain professions are reserved exclusively for Omani nationals.
The sponsoring employer must be a registered entity in Oman; the employee cannot self-sponsor.

outcome.duration_length: 2 years standard, renewable; temporary project-based visas 4-9 months

sources.title: Expat Focus -- Oman work permit process: Ministry of Labour Labour Clearance, Royal Oman Police employment visa, employer-only sponsorship, Omanisation quota/reserved-profession requirements, 2-year standard visa duration, 21-60 age range
